say:2:1330422001:1.male: We're collecting water! Naiya believes the water is good for plants.
say:2:1330422001:1.female: We're collecting water! Naiya believes the water is good for plants.

say:3:1330422002:1.text: We have a lot of plants at home, so the more water we collect, the longer it lasts.
say:3:1330422002:1.source_cn: 我们家养的植被很多，所以每次多接一些，就能多用一阵子。
say:3:1330422002:1.male: We have a lot of plants at home, so the more water we collect, the longer it lasts.
say:3:1330422002:1.female: We have a lot of plants at home, so the more water we collect, the longer it lasts.

say:4:1330422003:0.text: Yenia, come back! I know you're just trying to slack off by chatting!
say:4:1330422003:0.source_cn: 妹妹，快来提水！你就是想借着说话偷懒，别以为我不知道！
